constitution.title: Constitution of the Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia, Proclamation No. 1/1995
constitution.note: Arts. 50-54 (two federal houses; the House of Peoples' Representatives elected every five years by plurality in single-member constituencies, at most 550 members with at least 20 seats for minority nationalities), 61 (House of Federation members elected by the state councils, which may hold direct elections), 70 (President elected by a two-thirds vote of a joint session for six years, at most two terms), 73 (Prime Minister elected by the House from among its members)

hopr-history.note: The 1931 constitution's appointed chambers; the 1955 revision making the Chamber of Deputies directly elected (125 deputies, 250 senators appointed); the Derg's dissolution of parliament in September 1974; the 1987 PDRE constitution's National Shengo of 835 constituencies with a five-year term; the Transitional Government's 86-member Council of Representatives (1991-1995); the FDRE constitution adopted 29 Hidar 1987 E.C. and the House first elected in Ginbot 1987 E.C.

p1162.title: Ethiopian Electoral, Political Parties Registration and Elections Code of Conduct Proclamation No. 1162/2019 (Federal Negarit Gazette No. 97, 16 October 2019)
p1162.note: Art. 4 (plurality; regional councils may elect several members per constituency, filled in order of votes), 6 (types: general, local, by-election, re-election, referendum), 7 (general elections of the House and the regional state councils every five years, simultaneously), 8 (local elections of nationality-zone, zone, woreda, city, sub-city, and kebele councils), 9 (by-elections, including after a recall), 10 (re-elections), 11 (referendums), 13 (constituencies, including the minority-nationality constituencies)

classes.finest_note: Constituency forms with votes per candidate for 2021; polling-station tallies are posted at each station (Proc. 1162/2019 art. 16) but not published centrally
classes.note: 547 single-member constituencies elected by plurality every five years; at least 20 seats are reserved minority-nationality constituencies drawn inside the regions (Proc. 1162/2019 art. 13(1)(c)-(e)), so they are contests of this class. Polling was split in 1995 and 2000 (Somali later), in 2021 (21 June and 30 September; Tigray not held, and some constituencies in Amhara, Oromia, Benishangul-Gumuz, and SNNP postponed), and in 2026 (no polling in Tigray). Dates in 1995 and 2000 are the main polling days; the Board's page gives only the year.

classes.name_en: By-elections and re-elections to the House and the regional councils
classes.note: By-elections fill seats vacated for any reason, including recall (art. 9), within six months of the request and never in a council's last six months; re-elections rerun a constituency whose result the Board cancelled (art. 10). The Board reports 'various' by-elections and re-elections without a list (nebe-past); 2021 and 2026 recounts and re-elections are listed on the results page.

classes.name_en: President, elected by a joint session of the two federal houses
classes.note: Nominated by the House of Peoples' Representatives and elected by a two-thirds vote of a joint session with the House of Federation for six years, at most two terms. Elections of 1995, 2001, 2007, 2013, 2018, and 2024 are recorded in the joint sessions' minutes, which the houses do not publish online.

cadence.administered_by: Joint session of the House of Peoples' Representatives and the House of Federation

classes.name: ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር
classes.name_en: Prime Minister, elected by the House of Peoples' Representatives
classes.locator: https://www.hopr.gov.et/Home/AboutUs (the House named Meles Zenawi Prime Minister at its session in mid-Nehase 1987 E.C.)
classes.note: Elected by the House from among its members (constitution art. 73) at the opening of each term and on a vacancy (1995, 2000, 2005, 2010, 2012, 2015, 2018, 2021, 2026); usually by acclamation, and no division lists are published online.

classes.name: የፌዴሬሽን ምክር ቤት
classes.name_en: House of Federation, designated by the regional state councils
classes.disposition_reason: Members are chosen by each regional state council for its nations and nationalities (constitution art. 61(3)) without a published vote; Proclamation 1162/2019 art. 7(5) lets a council opt for direct election with the general election, which no council has notified the Board of.

classes.name: የክልል ምክር ቤቶች ምርጫ
classes.name_en: Regional state councils and the Addis Ababa and Dire Dawa city councils
classes.finest_note: Constituencies elect one or more members, filled in order of votes (Proc. 1162/2019 art. 4(1)); 684 constituencies and 2,916 seats for 2026
classes.note: Each regional state council is elected with the House on the same day; council sizes are set by regional law (Tigray 152, Oromia 537, Amhara 294, Somali 273; 2,916 seats in 14 councils for 2026). The Board counts the Addis Ababa (138, from 2026 158) and Dire Dawa (189) city councils with them: Addis Ababa's council was elected with the general elections of 2000 and 2005, in the local elections of 2008 and 2013, and again with the general elections from 2021. Regions changed as Sidama (2020), South West Ethiopia (2021), and South Ethiopia and Central Ethiopia (2023) split from SNNP, which ended in 2023. Tigray's council was not elected in 2021 or 2026.

cadence.locator: https://www.nebe.org.et/sites/default/files/Ethiopian-Electoral-Proclamtion-No-1162.pdf (art. 7(1)-(2): every five years, simultaneously with the House)

classes.name_en: Referendums on statehood and on boundaries and self-administration
classes.finest_note: 2023 results by zone and special woreda; boundary referendums by kebele in the Board's reports
classes.note: The Board runs a referendum when the body empowered by the constitution decides one: statehood referendums under art. 47(3) (Sidama 2019, South West Ethiopia 2021, the southern zones 2023 and the Wolayta re-run) and boundary or self-administration referendums referred by the House of Federation (Begi 1995 under the Transitional Charter, Oromia-Somali 2004, Wondo Genet 2008, Amhara-Qimant 2017). Eight in all (nebe-past). No national referendum is provided for; constitutional amendments go to the federal houses and the regional councils (art. 105).

classes.name: የብሔረሰብ ዞን፣ የዞን እና የክፍለ ከተማ ምክር ቤቶች
classes.name_en: Nationality-zone, zone, and sub-city councils (local elections)
classes.disposition_reason: The Board lists four local elections (nebe-past, nebe-cci) but publishes no local results, dates, or seat counts on nebe.org.et; the regional councils that set local seats publish none online.
classes.note: Elected in local elections under regional law, in proportional multi-member constituencies (Proc. 1162/2019 art. 13(2)); zone councils exist only in some regions (nationality zones in Amhara, zones of the former SNNP), sub-city councils in Addis Ababa.

classes.name: የወረዳ እና የከተማ ምክር ቤቶች
classes.disposition_reason: The Board lists four local elections (nebe-past, nebe-cci) but publishes no local results on nebe.org.et and no regional body publishes them online.
classes.note: Every woreda and town administration elects a council in local elections; 1,393 woreda-level units in the 2026 polling-station register outside Tigray.

classes.name: የቀበሌ ምክር ቤቶች
classes.disposition_reason: The Board lists four local elections (nebe-past, nebe-cci) but publishes no local results on nebe.org.et and no regional body publishes them online.
classes.note: The kebele is the smallest unit that elects anyone; 18,799 kebeles in the 2026 polling-station register outside Tigray.

classes.name: የክልል ርዕሳነ መስተዳድሮች፣ ከንቲባዎች እና አስተዳዳሪዎች
classes.name_en: Regional presidents, mayors, and zone and woreda administrators chosen by their councils
classes.disposition_reason: Chosen by vote of the regional, city, zone, or woreda council from among its members under regional constitutions and city charters; no tallies are published and the Board does not run them.

classes.name: የመራጮች አመኔታ ማጣት (recall)
classes.note: Constituents may recall a member of any council (constitution art. 12(3)); the Board's Directive 22 sets the procedure and an accepted recall leads to a by-election (class by_elections). No recall vote is on the Board's record.

classes.name: ዳኞች
classes.disposition_reason: Federal and regional judges are appointed by the legislatures on nomination by the judicial administration councils (constitution art. 81); none is elected.

classes.name: የፓርቲ ዕጩ ምርጫ
classes.disposition_reason: Parties choose candidates by their own rules; Proclamation 1162/2019 provides no state-run nominating contest, and independents qualify by endorsement signatures.

classes.name: የሕገ መንግሥት ጉባኤ ምርጫ
classes.locator: https://www.hopr.gov.et/Home/AboutUs (the constitution commission's draft, adopted 29 Hidar 1987 E.C.)
classes.disposition_reason: Elected under the Transitional Government before the Board's founding; no official canvass by constituency is published online by the Board or the House.
classes.note: The assembly adopted the FDRE constitution on 8 December 1994.

classes.name: የሽግግር ወቅት የክልልና የወረዳ ምክር ቤቶች ምርጫ
classes.name_en: Transitional regional and woreda council elections (1992)
classes.locator: https://www.hopr.gov.et/Home/AboutUs (Transitional Government, Sene 1983 to Hamle 1987 E.C.)
classes.disposition_reason: Run by the Transitional Government's election commission under the Transitional Charter; no official results are published online.

classes.name: ብሔራዊ ሸንጎ
classes.name_en: National Shengo of the People's Democratic Republic of Ethiopia (1987)
classes.locator: https://www.hopr.gov.et/Home/AboutUs (five-year term, members elected from 835 constituencies)
classes.disposition_reason: One-party election under the 1987 PDRE constitution; no official canvass is published online, and the Shengo's records were not taken over by an institution that publishes them.

classes.name: የኢሕዲሪ ሕገ መንግሥት ሕዝበ ውሳኔ
classes.name_en: Constitutional referendum of the People's Democratic Republic (1987)
classes.locator: https://www.hopr.gov.et/Home/AboutUs (the PDRE constitution, in force 2 Meskerem 1980 E.C.)
classes.disposition_reason: No official canvass of the 1987 referendum is published online.

classes.name: የሕግ መምሪያ ምክር ቤት
classes.locator: https://www.hopr.gov.et/Home/AboutUs (the 1948 E.C. revision made the Chamber of Deputies directly elected; the Derg dissolved parliament after 2 Meskerem 1967 E.C.)
classes.disposition_reason: Elections of 1957, 1961, 1965, 1969, and 1973 under the 1955 Revised Constitution had no parties and no published canvass; the House's history gives no counts.
classes.note: The Senate was appointed by the Emperor; under the 1931 constitution deputies were chosen by notables, not elected.
